selection: At most eight exploratory contexts selected from the previously saved screen; no defended-castle result inspected before freezing.
objective: Attacker victory requires castle destruction by the deadline. Hero deaths alone do not end the simulation. Alive castle at deadline is a defended objective with possible surviving enemies.
decision: If baseline already establishes castle-raid partnership, no new mechanic is needed. Candidate acceptance additionally requires improved partner gain and a meaningful frontline counter; no post-hoc victory reinterpretation of legacy data.
